integrity: The complete mathematical claims and proof appear in RESULT.md. The numerical checker is supporting evidence, not an exhaustive or independently certified proof.
scientific_limitations: Real finite-dimensional \(\ell_p\), \(1<p<\infty\), cone slope \(\kappa>0\). Sharp Lipschitz constant in dimension two only; higher-dimensional result is a qualitative nonexpansivity classification, not a formula for its full Lipschitz constant.
title: Exact planar stability and nonexpansivity rigidity for \(\ell_p\) projections onto scaled Lorentz cones
